classification.difficultyReason: Identify corresponding vertices in nested triangles and use proportional sides; part a also requires an intermediate length from Pythagoras’ theorem.

content.prompt: Write down a pair of similar triangles and find the value of each pronumeral.

spec.description: Right triangle ABC with altitude BD meeting AC at D. Both source right-angle markers and all point and length labels are retained. Ordinary blue source strokes are rendered in house black.
spec.mathematics: A, D and C are collinear; AB is perpendicular to BC; BD is perpendicular to AC; AB=13 cm, AD=5 cm, BC=a cm and DC=b cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels appear; BD and the requested lengths are not supplied.

answer.short:
$\triangle BAD\sim\triangle CAB$; $a=31\tfrac15$, $b=28\tfrac45$.

Use Pythagoras to find $BD$, then ratios of matching sides.
answer.worked:
$\angle BDA=\angle CBA=90^\circ$ and $\angle BAD=\angle CAB$ (common angle at $A$). Hence $\triangle BAD\sim\triangle CAB$ (AAA).

By Pythagoras’ theorem in $\triangle ABD$:
$$\begin{align*}BD^2&=13^2-5^2\\BD^2&=144\\BD&=12\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$
Matching sides of the similar triangles give:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{BC}{BD}&=\frac{AB}{AD}\\\frac{a}{12}&=\frac{13}{5}\\a&=\frac{156}{5}=31\tfrac15.\end{align*}$$
Also:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{AC}{AB}&=\frac{AB}{AD}\\\frac{5+b}{13}&=\frac{13}{5}\\5+b&=\frac{169}{5}\\b&=\frac{144}{5}=28\tfrac45.\end{align*}$$
Thus $BC=31\tfrac15\text{ cm}$ and $DC=28\tfrac45\text{ cm}$.

spec.description: Triangle JLM with K on JL and N on JM. Matching upward single arrows mark KN parallel to LM. All source labels are retained, with ordinary source blue strokes rendered black.
spec.mathematics: JK=4 cm, KL=6 cm, LM=8 cm, KN=x cm and KN parallel to LM. No right angle is given.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied measurements, vertex labels, parallel marks and the unknown x appear.

answer.worked:
$\angle KJN=\angle LJM$ (common angle at $J$), and $\angle JKN=\angle JLM$ (corresponding angles, $KN\parallel LM$). Hence $\triangle JKN\sim\triangle JLM$ (AAA).

$$\begin{align*}JL&=4+6\\JL&=10\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$
Using matching sides:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{KN}{LM}&=\frac{JK}{JL}\\\frac{x}{8}&=\frac{4}{10}\\x&=\frac{16}{5}=3\tfrac15.\end{align*}$$
Thus $KN=3\tfrac15\text{ cm}$.
